newsitem.title: USA: Pitt-Des Moines to build facility, close another.
newsitem.headline: Pitt-Des Moines to build facility, close another.

text.p: Pitt-Des Moines Inc said its PDM Strocal Inc unit plans to begin construction of a new structural steel fabricating facility in the southwestern part of the U.S.

PDM also said it has decided to close its structural steel fabricating facility in Melrose Park, Ill., and will redeploy some employees and equipment to the new plant as well as to existing bridge fabricating plants in Wisconsin which are also slated for expansion.

The company said the new facility is expected to be operational in the third quarter of 1997. The new facility will expand the capabilities of PDM Strocal to fabricate and erect structural steel buildings in the California, Nevada and Arizona markets.
